family: Civil protection or recovery of possession against interference; distinguish ownership, procedural route and scope.
ordering: One local metadata pass; existing saved rank then document ID for relevant primary case metadata.
If fewer than five sources, one-hop citations in Guide case order 789051,1418721,1841885, then source position, then citation text order; merge repeated names before full reading.
At most three targeted search queries to resolve public source URLs; ordinary read/open not model annotations.
eligibility: A civil possession protection/recovery issue actually decided, not only cited.
Full target judgment available with document identity and stable locations.
Different dispute from Guide cases; known related decisions grouped.
Any prior development/citation use recorded; calibration is TRAIN only, never locked test.
exclusions: Pure title/adverse-possession disputes with no selected possession-protection/interference issue.
Only rent-control entitlement issues without this issue family.
Incomplete sources or identity conflicts; do not summarize missing text.
selection: First five eligible different dispute groups in saved order; stop at five or twenty full reads. No outcome or model-benefit selection.
representation: Existing v4 interfaces; 5-10 source-anchored propositions per case as a target, preserve decisive opposition and genuine gaps. Codex-assisted preparation is not independent web annotation or human gold.
inputs: Complete judgment for reconstruction, final disposition comparison-only. Original exhibits not presumed obtained.
sealed: Do not inspect sealed content or labels; do not reallocate.
legal_approval: PENDING_QUALIFIED_REVIEW; not a blocker to preparation.
stop: Deliver bounded five-case packets or actual shortfall, coverage and cost. No new cohort model calls, rule induction, GNN, commit or push.
